verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents call the Stripe API, plus the Invoicing API, official libraries and a CLI, so a programmatic agent surface clearly exists. However, the evidence covers invoices only: credit adjustments appear only as a Dashboard credit-note feature, and nothing shows subscription creation, plan changes or permission scoping for agents. Missing for 10: evidence of subscription create/plan-change operations via API/MCP, API-level credit application, scoped/restricted credentials for agents, and independent hands-on corroboration.
